propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py) has zero callers following bug 3b5f which removed all producers and dispatch consumers.
The port's original purpose (same-pass issue re-creation) is ruled out by prior operator decision and cannot be restored.

Deletion is behavior-neutral and provably safe: proven by both semantic search (Serena returned empty for SupportsAbsenceProbe references) and repo-wide string grep (matches only in port itself, its tests, and documentation).
The outbound probe leaf (_apply_outbound_probe, (outbound, probe) dispatch arm, MutationKind.probe under Direction.outbound) is separate, live, and must not be touched.
Orphaned configuration keys (jira.resolved_statuses, reconciler.resolved_statuses) are deferred to a follow-up ticket and tracked via a read-via marker in the config gate.
